{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if revenue has thousands separators
print("Sample of revenue strings:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, strip any non-numeric characters and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:", df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())"}
